basic_info.description: Modern 1 bed, 1 bath, + LOFT, very rare townhome, designed by Award Winning Architect, Donald MacDonald and located right in the heart of the SOMA district of Downtown San Francisco! Featuring high-end contemporary finishes, beautiful oak wood flooring, bonus loft, bedroom with private balcony, a stunning gourmet kitchen, massive gas fireplace and two skylights which allow plenty of sunshine. Entry level contains a private attached garage with laundry area. Up the stairs is a light and airy bedroom with high ceilings, hardwood floors, private balcony; one full bathroom is located just off the bedroom. The spacious main living space on the third level features oak wood flooring, a gorgeous gourmet kitchen that boasts black stone countertops, beige wood cabinetry for lots or storage space and stainless-steel appliances including a six-burner gas stove. An additional loft area is the perfect bonus space and can be used as an office or entertainment area for guests!
